Annual Report 2025 年報
            China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited (the “Company”;
            stock code: 2319) and its subsidiaries (collectively “the
            Group” or “Mengniu”) mainly manufacture and distribute
            quality dairy products in China. It is one of the leading dairy
            product manufacturers in China, with MENGNIU as its core
            brand. Mengniu offers diversified products including liquid
CORPORATE   milk products, ice cream, milk formula and cheese. In March
            2014, Mengniu became a Hang Seng Index constituent,
 PROFILE    making it the first blue-chip Chinese dairy product

 公司簡介       manufacturer. Mengniu maintained its MSCI ESG Rating of
            “AA”, which is also the highest rating received by
            comprehensive dairy companies in China. Mengniu is a
            constituent of the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Index,
            Hang Seng (Mainland and Hong Kong) Corporate
            Sustainability Index, Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability
            Benchmark Index and HSI ESG Enhanced Select Index.

            中國蒙牛乳業有限公司（「本公司」；股份代號：2319）及其子公司（統
            稱「本集團」或「蒙牛」）主要於中國生產及銷售優質乳製品。憑藉其
            主要品牌蒙牛 ，蒙牛已成為中國領先的乳製品生產商之一。蒙牛提
            供多元化的產品，包括液態奶、冰淇淋、奶粉及奶酪產品。二零一四
            年三月，蒙牛獲納入恒生指數成份股，成為首家中國乳製品企業藍
            籌股。蒙牛保持MSCI ESG評級AA級，是中國綜合型乳企獲得的最
            高評級，並入選恒生可持續發展企業指數、恒生內地及香港可持續
            發展企業指數、恒生可持續發展企業基準指數及恒指ESG增強精選
            指數。

In 2025, Chinese dairy industry was under a complex and                    二零二五年，中國乳製品行業處於複雜的發展變
evolving development landscape, characterized by low raw milk              局中，原奶價格低位運行、消費需求迭代升級、
prices, iterative upgrades in consumer demand, accelerated                 渠道場景加速重構、競爭環境持續變化，行業整
restructuring of channel scenarios and a continuously evolving             體呈現「短期承壓築底、長期提質升級」的鮮明特
competitive landscape. As a whole, the industry exhibited the              徵。蒙牛始終秉持「強乳興農」和「每天一斤奶、
distinct signs of short-term stabilization while pursuing long-term        強壯中國人」的初心，堅守「點滴營養，綻放每個
quality upgrades. Mengniu has remained true to its original                生命」的企業使命，堅定推進「一體兩翼」戰略，
mission of “Dairy Excellence, Rural Revitalization (强乳興農)” and             以創新驅動品類迭代、以品牌引領價值升級、以
“500g of milk a day to keep Chinese People strong”, while                  數智賦能全鏈提效、以責任踐行企業擔當，在穿
adhering to its corporate mission of “Every drop of nutrition,             越行業週期的過程中，彰顯了領軍企業的穩健韌
makes every life thrive”. The Company resolutely advanced its              性。
“One Core, Two Wings” strategy, driving product category
iteration through innovation, leading value upgrades through
branding, empowering whole-chain efficiency through digital
intelligence, and fulfilling corporate responsibilities with dedication.
Throughout the process of navigating industry cycles, Mengniu
has demonstrated the resilient stability of an industry leader.

           Hedging                                                            對沖
           The Group designates certain derivatives as hedging                本集團將若干衍生工具指定為對沖工
           instruments to hedge the variability in cash flows                 具，以對沖因外匯匯率及浮動利率借
           associated with highly probable forecast transactions              貸變動而產生的高度可預期的交易相
           arising from changes in foreign exchange rates and                 關的現金流量變動。部分借貸被指定
           variable rate borrowings. Some borrowings are                      為海外業務之投資淨額的外匯風險的
           designated as hedges of the foreign exchange risk of               對沖。
           a net investment in a foreign operation.

           Cash flow hedges                                                   現金流量對沖
           When a derivative is designated as a cash flow                     當某項衍生工具已指定用作現金流對
           hedging instrument, the effective portion of changes in            沖工具時，衍生工具公允值變動的有
           the fair value of the derivative is recognised in OCI              效部分於其他全面收益確認，並於權
           and accumulated in the hedging reserve within equity.              益內於對沖儲備累計。於其他全面收
           The effective portion that is recognised in OCI is                 益確認的有效部分僅限於自對沖開始
           limited to the cumulative change in fair value of the              起按現值基準釐定的對沖項目公允值
           hedged item, determined on a present value basis,                  的累計變動。任何無效部分則即時在
           from inception of the hedge. Any ineffective portion is            損益中確認。
           recognised immediately in profit or loss.

            When the hedged forecast transaction subsequently                 當預期交易的對沖其後引致需確認非
            results in the recognition of a non-financial item such           金融項目（如存貨）時，於對沖儲備累
            as inventory, the amount accumulated in the hedging               計的金額從儲備中剔除，並在確認時
            reserve is removed from the reserve and is included               直接計入非金融項目的初始成本。
            directly in the initial cost of the non-financial item
            when it is recognised.

            For all other hedged forecast transactions, the amount            就所有其他對沖預測交易而言，於對
            accumulated in the hedging reserve is reclassified                沖儲備中累計的數額透過其他全面收
            through OCI to profit or loss as a reclassification               益重新分類至損益作為對沖預期未來
            adjustment in the same period or periods during                   現金流量影響損益的同一期間或多個
            which the hedged expected future cash flows affect                期間的重新分類調整。倘對沖不再符
            profit or loss. If the hedge no longer meets the criteria         合對沖會計處理標準或對沖工具被出
            for hedge accounting or the hedging instrument is                 售、到期、終止或行使時，則往後終
            sold, expires, is terminated or is exercised, then                止使用對沖會計處理。當對沖會計處
            hedge accounting is discontinued prospectively. When              理已終止使用，對沖儲備中累計的數
            hedge accounting is discontinued, the amount that                 額仍為權益，直至交易發生，並根據
            has been accumulated in the hedging reserve remains               上述政策確認。
            in equity until the transaction occurs and it is
            recognised in accordance with the above policy.

               hierarchy as defined in IFRS/HKFRS 13, Fair                           公允值計量 的定義分類為三個
               value measurement . The level into which a fair                       層 級。公 允 值 計 量 的 層 級 分 類
               value measurement is classified is determined                         乃參考下列估值方式採用數據

               technique as follows:

               •   Level 1 valuations:    Fair value measured using only Level 1 inputs i.e. unadjusted quoted
                                          prices in active markets for identical assets or liabilities at the
                                          measurement date
                   第一級估值：                 僅使用第一級輸入數據（即相同資產或負債於計量日在活躍市場的未經調
                                          整報價）計量的公允值

               •   Level 2 valuations:    Fair value measured using Level 2 inputs i.e. observable inputs which fail
                                          to meet Level 1, and not using significant unobservable inputs.
                                          Unobservable inputs are inputs for which market data are not available
                   第二級估值：                 使用第二級輸入數據（即未能符合第一級標準的可觀察的輸入數據，且未
                                          採用重大不可觀察輸入數據）計量的公允值。不可觀察輸入數據為無市場
                                          數據的輸入數據

               •   Level 3 valuations:    Fair value measured using significant unobservable inputs
                   第三級估值：                 使用重大不可觀察輸入數據計量的公允值
